caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, black-colored wrought iron gate or fence panel positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The design consists of a rectangular frame with vertical bars that curve into arches at the top, each bar adorned with symmetrical decorative elements such as flourishes, circles, and pointed finials. In the middle section, a row of circular motifs intersects with the vertical bars. The top of the gate extends above the rectangular frame in an elaborate crest, featuring symmetrically arranged scrollwork, leafy shapes, and a central shell-like motif at the apex. The drawing is meticulously rendered with fine shading to indicate depth and detail, and there is a small handwritten signature, "E.H. Shellaat," located below the lower right corner of the gate.
title: Gate
